name: Oberoi Three Sixty West
address: Dr Annie Besant Road (at Sadanand Hasu Tandel Marg), Worli, Mumbai 400025
amenities: Access to The Ritz-Carlton hotel services
description: A two-tower mixed-use development on Annie Besant Road, Worli, built by Oasis Realty, a joint venture of Oberoi Realty and the Sahana Group, with landowner partners. Kohn Pedersen Fox designed it and Samsung C&T built it. One tower houses The Ritz-Carlton Mumbai and the other holds branded sea-facing residences. It is one of India's costliest residential addresses, with developer realisations above Rs 1.2 lakh per sq ft of carpet in 2025 and 2026.
notes: Promoter on MahaRERA: Oasis Realty, whose members are Oberoi Constructions, Sky Lark Buildcon, Shree Vrunda Enterprises and Astir Realty LLP. MahaRERA lists 284 units: Tower A 28 (carpet 817.48 to 1,084.73 sq m) and Tower B 256 (304.86 to 1,025.32 sq m). Land is 6,405.56 sq m, about 1.58 acres. Floors: CTBUH and Wikipedia give the residential Tower B as 260 m with 66 floors and Tower A as 255.6 m with 52 floors. Wikipedia's text is inconsistent about which tower holds the hotel, while news reports place the residences in Tower B. Construction started on 18 Jun 2011, the tower topped out in March 2019, and Wikipedia gives completion as 29 May 2023. possession_actual uses that completion date; the OC date itself was not found. possession_promised is the MahaRERA proposed completion date. launch_date is omitted because no dated launch was found. Units were selling by Nov 2014, when Abhishek Bachchan bought, and Square Yards' 'Sep 2017' looks like the RERA registration date. Total carpet area per Oberoi disclosures (via ICICI Direct) is 549,191 sq ft. Price spread: landowner-share inventory sells well below the developer's own sales. For example, Reliance's Sep 2026 duplex from the landowner partners came to about Rs 76,800/sq ft, against Oberoi's Rs 1.5 lakh+ in the same quarter. ICICI Direct notes that Q1FY27 had many resale and landowner sales, and that landowner inventory is now exhausted. Notable buyers and sellers: Abhishek Bachchan (bought 2014, sold 2021), Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna (sold for Rs 80 crore in 2025), Siddhartha Sacheti (two units, Rs 160 crore, 2025), a Zandu promoter-family firm (Rs 110.41 crore, 2026) and Reliance Industries (Rs 75.11 crore duplex, 2026). Enrichment (Nov 2026): Oberoi's earnings calls give quarterly bookings for the project, which are recorded as computed price points. The areas in those calls are cumulative 4.32 lakh sq ft (Dec 2017), 5.5 lakh (Mar 2019), about 6 lakh (Dec 2019) and 6.6 lakh sq ft (Mar 2021) against a stated total of about 22 lakh sq ft, so they are not on the 549,191 sq ft RERA-carpet basis of the ICICI Direct series and are marked basis unknown. The cumulative booking value of Rs 1,716 crore over 4.32 lakh sq ft to Dec 2017 implies an average of about Rs 39,700/sq ft across all bookings since sales began (computed), which is the closest figure found to a launch-era price; no dated launch price list was found. Oberoi says it receives 80% of the receivables and its partner 20% until Oberoi recovers its investment, after which the split becomes proportionate (Q3FY20 call, 10 Feb 2020). OC: management expected part OC by Sep 2019 and full OC by end-2019 (May 2019 call), then OC by April 2020 (Feb 2020 call). Broker and portal pages say the OC has been received, but no OC date was found, so oc_date is left out. units_sold (71 of 284) is Square Yards' MahaRERA snapshot, which it also shows for June 2022 and Nov 2025; it is stale and only roughly matches Oberoi's 'about 30% sold' by area in 2020. transactions_12m (6, Nov 2025 to Oct 2026) is from Square Yards, whose page elsewhere cites 9 or 10 deals. maintenance_psf_month is computed from a broker listing's 'about Rs 3 lakh a month' divided by the 5,235 sq ft carpet of the listed 4 BHK (low confidence). clubhouse_sqft (Residents' Club of about 80,000 sq ft) is also from that broker listing (Gupta & Sen). Car parks vary by unit: 3 for the 5,395 sq ft carpet unit and 4 for the 6,830 and 7,527 sq ft units in reported deals, so car_parks_per_unit is not set. A consultant portfolio (Meinhardt) lists an Oberoi Worli KPF project as LEED Gold, but it does not name Three Sixty West, so green_certification is not set. CTBUH lists LERA as structural engineer, KONE elevators and a LEED consultant (En3), and gives Tower B as 66 floors above ground plus 4 basements. Shahid Kapoor and Mira Rajput separately bought a 42nd/43rd-floor duplex here for a reported Rs 56 crore, registered 12 Jul 2018 (area not reported). Nearest metro: Square Yards' metro guide places the Aqua Line's Worli station under Dr Annie Besant Road, the project's road; no distance is sourced. No sourced road distances to BKC or the airport were found.
architect: Kohn Pedersen Fox (design); Wesymor Consultants and A+I Design (architects of record)
jv_partner: Sahana Group (landowner partners Sky Lark Buildcon, Shree Vrunda Enterprises and Astir Realty LLP in Oasis Realty)
floor_rise_notes: Prices include a floor-rise component, so per-sq-ft realisations swing with the floors sold (Vikas Oberoi, Jan 2018 earnings call). The rate itself is not disclosed.
payment_plan: Ready to move: full payment (broker listing). Oberoi moved to an all-inclusive ticket price, GST included, in 2019.

unit_types.notes: 5,235 sq ft carpet asked at Rs 78.50 crore (Gupta & Sen listing). 6,130 sq ft carpet registered at Rs 80 crore (Oct 2025) and 6,830 sq ft carpet at Rs 80 crore (Jan 2025, resale). Square Yards shows a stale Rs 45 crore for 5,235 sq ft, which is ignored.

6,651 sq ft carpet asked at Rs 99 crore (Gupta & Sen listing). A 7,303 sq ft RERA carpet unit on the 62nd floor registered at Rs 110.41 crore from Oberoi Realty in Jul 2026. The configuration of the 7,303 sq ft unit is not stated in the report.
A 49th/50th-floor duplex in Tower B, sold by landowner partners to Reliance Industries in Sep 2026.
Converted from MahaRERA carpet ranges of 304.86 to 1,025.32 sq m (Tower B) and 817.48 to 1,084.73 sq m (Tower A).

news.title: Oberoi Realty signs Samsung C&T for Worli project
news.summary: Samsung C&T appointed main contractor for Oberoi's Worli mixed-use towers, later named Three Sixty West. Construction began in June 2011.

news.title: Shahid Kapoor, Mira Rajput buy duplex worth Rs 56 crore in Worli
news.summary: A 42nd/43rd-floor duplex in Three Sixty West with six parking spaces, registered on 12 Jul 2018 for a reported Rs 56 crore with Rs 2.91 crore stamp duty. The area was not reported.

news.title: Full moon finale for Mumbai's newest icon
news.summary: Topping out of Three Sixty West, with the spire capped by a bronze Ashoka Chakra finial and a ceremony attended by CM Devendra Fadnavis. The date is approximate: March 2019 per Wikipedia.

news.title: Oberoi Realty Q3FY20 earnings call: Three Sixty West OC expected in April
news.summary: About 6 lakh sq ft booked out of roughly 22 lakh sq ft; OC expected by April 2020. Vikas Oberoi says construction is now funded from collections and receivables are split 80:20 with the partner until Oberoi recovers its investment.

news.title: Abhishek Bachchan, Aishwarya sell luxurious Mumbai apartment for Rs 45 crore
news.summary: Abhishek Bachchan sells his 7,527 sq ft 37th-floor apartment for Rs 45.75 crore. He bought it in Nov 2014 for Rs 41.14 crore.

news.title: Actor Shahid Kapoor rents out luxury apartment in Mumbai for Rs 20 lakh per month
news.summary: The 5,395 sq ft carpet unit bought for Rs 58.6 crore in May 2024 is leased for five years from Rs 20.5 lakh a month, with a Rs 1.23 crore deposit.

news.title: Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna Sell Oberoi 360 West Apartment for ₹80 Crore
news.summary: A 6,830 sq ft (RERA carpet) 39th-floor Tower B unit sells for Rs 80 crore, about Rs 1.17 lakh/sq ft. The agreement was dated 31 Jan 2025, and the article date is approximate.

news.title: Siddhartha Sacheti, Brother of CaratLane Founder, Purchases ₹160-Crore Residences in Oberoi 360 West, Mumbai
news.summary: Two units of 6,130 sq ft carpet each sell for Rs 80 crore apiece, about Rs 1.3 lakh/sq ft, per Zapkey.

news.title: Oberoi Realty Q1FY27 result update: lower sales velocity at 360 West
news.summary: Three Sixty West bookings fall to Rs 110 crore in Q1FY27, down 48% YoY. The company says landowner-share inventory has been exhausted, Ritz-Carlton interiors are targeted for completion by Q4FY27, and 360 West carries the highest margins in its portfolio.

news.title: Mumbai Real Estate: Ex-Promoter Family Of Zandu Pharmaceuticals Buys ₹110.41 Crore Luxury Apartment In Worli
news.summary: A 62nd-floor Tower B unit of 7,303 sq ft RERA carpet is bought from Oberoi Realty for Rs 110.41 crore, about Rs 1.51 lakh/sq ft. It was registered on 29 Jul 2026.

news.title: Reliance Industries purchases 9,781-sq-ft luxury duplex in Mumbai's Worli for Rs 75.11 crore
news.summary: Reliance Industries buys a 49th/50th-floor duplex from Oasis Realty's landowner partners for Rs 75.11 crore, about Rs 76,800/sq ft of carpet. It was registered on 11 Sep 2026.

news.title: Mumbai: 6,831 Sq Ft Worli Luxury Flat Leased For ₹28.5 Lakh Monthly Rent
news.summary: A Damani family-office entity leases a 19th-floor Tower B flat to IVL Dhunseri Petrochem for three years from Rs 28.5 lakh a month, per Zapkey.
